name: Toda Masumi
source:
A young girl living next to Yuuta's house.
She is unnaturally shy. It's just a phase, she'll grow out of it, some say... Actually no, not really, she really has always been like that.
However, she is also prone to do some bold stuff...

[From in-game charater profile]
